## Event Facility

The hackathon will be held at [ESA ESRIN](https://www.esa.int/About_Us/ESRIN) in Frascati, a small town 20km south of Rome, Italy.
Power supply and WiFi access will be available at the venue.
If you have non-European power plugs, please bring an appropriate adapter.

### Compute

Please bring your own laptop to work on at the hackathon.
You will have access to the [EarthCODE compute platform](https://earthcode.esa.int/ecosystem#accessible-computation-esa-and-partner-cloud-computing-platforms), which is a cloud-based environment for running Jupyter notebooks and other tools.

## Transportation

Travel to and from Frascati is the responsibility of the participants.
The closest international airport is Rome Fiumicino (FCO), which is approximately 50km from Frascati.
See [Getting to ESRIN](https://www.esa.int/About_Us/Getting_to_ESRIN) for more information on how to get to Frascati from Rome.
Some travel support is available, and will be provided on a case-by-case basis.
See the [registration](registration.qmd) page for more information.

### Daily Courtesy Transport  

The ESRIN facility is located approximately 2.5km outside Frascati.
There will be a courtesy bus to take participants from Frascati to ESRIN in the morning and back to Frascati in the afternoon each day of the hackathon. The pick-up and drop-off point will be at [Piazza Guglielmo Marconi](https://maps.app.goo.gl/d58MdaqwnDBaw8xf8?g_st=ic).

## Food

Lunch and a morning and afternoon snack/coffee will be served each day at the ESRIN canteen.
On the evening of the first day, we will have an Icebreaker event at the ESRIN canteen, with non-alcoholic drinks and snacks provided.
Breakfast and dinner are not provided.
